text: Tiago, it's Michael. Listen, I just got off a call with our warehouse and they tell me the second batch is not coming this week. That was news to me. I am not calling to complain, I am calling because I found out from the wrong person. If something moves, I need to hear it from you first, even when there is nothing I can do about it. Can you send me something short every Monday? Not a long report. Just where we are and what is stuck. Thanks.
The blocker is the tooling supplier.
The first batch left the factory on Monday.
We start production the day we get your sign-off.
We're running about four days behind.
What I need from you is a decision on the second batch.
By Friday we'll have the sign-off.
